title: Sealey RS600 RoadStart® Lithium-Ion Jump-Starter Power Pack | 12v/600a
description_html:
Sealey RS600 RoadStart® Lithium-Ion Jump-Starter Power Pack

Both ultra-compact and ultra-lightweight, the Sealey RS600 RoadStart® Jump-Starter Power Pack fits comfortably in your pocket.

The Sealey RS600 comprises a long-lasting and fast-charging lithium-ion battery with one, 5v/1.5a Micro USB input; and one, 5v/2.1a USB Type-A outlet (the latter is ideal for charging or powering small, low-demand electronic items).

The waterproofed Sealey RS600 benefits from a handy integrated torch, and is capable of firing-up a standard 4-litre petrol engine, or a standard 2.5-litre diesel engine.

With the Sealey RS600, you’ll also get full protection against reverse polarity, short circuit and overload.

You might also be interested in the Sealey SBC4 Fully Automatic Battery Charger/Maintainer.

  • Auxiliary output: USB (x1) – 5v/2.1a
  • Cable and clamp length: 385mm
  • Capacity: 7.2Ah @ 3.7v or 1.8Ah @ 14.8v
  • Maximum current: 600a peak / 300a cranking
  • Maximum starting capacity: 4-litre petrol / 2.5-litre diesel
  • Net weight: 0.36kg
  • Size (W x D x H): 85 x 27 x 140mm
  • Voltage: 12v

title: Sealey SBC4 Fully Automatic Battery Charger/Maintainer | 12v/4Ah
description_html:
Sealey SBC4 Fully Automatic Battery Charger/Maintainer

Charge and maintain a range of 12v battery types – including lead-acid, gel, AGM/EFB and Leisure – with the fully automatic Sealey SBC4!

Flexible in use, the Sealey SBC4 is capable of recovering and charging a fully discharged battery, and offers a useful sulfation-repair function.

Protections include overcharging, over-voltage, over-temperature, short-circuit and reverse polarity; LED indicators provide at-a-glance information on power status and charging-stages.

The Sealey SBC4 is backed by a reassuring two-year manufacturer’s warranty.

Click here to check out Sealey‘s aluminium booster cables.

Sealey SBC4 – Specifications:

Cable and clamp length: 1m
Net weight: 0.405Kg
Supply: 230v
Output: 12v
Output charge: 4a
Battery range: 40 to 80Ah
Charging-cable length: 1m
IP rating: IP33
Dimensions: 150 x 69 x 42mm
